title: Piano Movers in Torrance | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Hillside steps, condo lifts and truck-parking rules: piano movers in Torrance arrive as a crew of four, on an hourly clock with a flat $200 add-on.
heroSubtitle: A crew of four, a piano board and a padded truck — your instrument moves on the same hourly clock as the rest of the house.

faq.question: Do four movers really turn up for one upright?
faq.answer: Yes. The piano add-on is sold only with a crew of four, whatever the instrument is. Three movers can take a heavy piece of furniture, but a piano wants a hand on every corner and someone free to call the route, hold a door and set the board.

faq.question: How is the piano billed if my whole house moves the same day?
faq.answer: One clock covers all of it. The crew of four bills by the hour from arrival, the instrument adds a flat $200, and the three-hour minimum applies to the job as a whole. Nothing is invoiced twice because the piano and the sofa shared a truck.

faq.question: Where will the truck stand on my street?
faq.answer: Wherever the code allows it and the ramp still reaches your door. Vehicles longer than twenty feet, wider than seven or taller than eight are treated as oversized and kept off public streets under section 61.12.020, with exceptions that cover commercial vehicles serving a residence. We settle the stop with you before the date so nobody is hunting for space on the morning.

faq.question: My building wants a certificate of insurance. Can you send one?
faq.answer: Yes. A COI costs $50 and is issued in the name the building gives us, so send their requirements together with your booking. With the paperwork accepted in advance, the crew of four starts at the lift instead of at the front desk.

faq.question: Will you tune the instrument once it is in place?
faq.answer: No. We move the piano and set it exactly where you want it, take the covers off and check the legs and pedals, but tuning is a technician’s trade and is booked separately once the instrument has settled in its new room.

faq.question: Can you move a piano the same day I call?
faq.answer: Often, yes. A same-day date depends on a crew of four being open, and our hours run Monday through Sunday, 8AM to 6PM. Call 909-443-0004 early and we will tell you straight away whether the day holds.
